items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: The transcript only identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. No personal or professional relationship between Sheila Jordan and Monk Rowe is described in the provided text.

ctx.x: Sheila was interviewed in Middleburgh, NY on May 11, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive outside Middleburgh, New York. I’m very pleased to have jazz musician Sheila Jordan with me today. Thank you for inviting us into your house.
